title: Bureau of Customs seizes P661M worth of marijuana, shabu
summary: The Bureau of Customs at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport has confiscated 350 kilos of illegal drugs worth P661 million in six inbound shipments examined at a warehouse in Pasay City.

blocks.text: The Bureau of Customs at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport has confiscated 350 kilos of illegal drugs worth P661 million in six inbound shipments examined at a warehouse in Pasay City.
In a statement, the BOC said its personnel intercepted high-grade marijuana (kush), methamphetamine hydrochloride (shabu), and acetylcodeine.
The seized drugs included 307.866 kilograms of kush in two shipments from Thailand and sent by the same shipper.
One shipment bound for Bulacan yielded 54.382 kilograms worth an estimated P65.26 million, while the other shipment bound for Caloocan had 484 kilograms worth an estimated P304.18 million.
Both shipments were declared as children’s toys.
Customs personnel also intercepted 42.884 kilograms of shabu worth an estimated P291.61 million from three shipments.

A shipment from Kenya yielded 39.418 kilograms, while two shipments from Malaysia yielded 2.630 kilograms and 0.836 kilogram, respectively. A separate shipment from Canada yielded one gram of acetylcodeine worth P1,508.

Since January 2026, the BOC has intercepted an estimated P7.92 billion worth of illegal drugs in 414 seizure operations nationwide, in line with President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.’s directive to strengthen border protection and prevent illegal drugs from reaching Filipino communities. –NB, GMA News
